title: Up/Down Quark Polarity — Project Model Recovery and Physics Audit
status: conversation archaeology: symbolic polarity built on real quark charge arithmetic; later assistant expansions over-literalized it
abstract: The Up/Down Quark Polarity record contains two different objects that become useful only when they are kept typed apart. The first is established particle physics: up and down quarks carry fractional electric charges, combine as uud and udd in proton/neutron valence structure, and participate in QCD, electroweak and electromagnetic interactions according to their quantum numbers. The second is a project-specific symbolic coordinate that uses the words up and down for ascent/integration versus descent/grounding. The charge arithmetic is real; the symbolic polarity is a mnemonic state variable and is not quark flavor evolution, gravity, morality or consciousness. The scientific value of the record is therefore type discipline and a clean future model-building route: if a physical Potato field is ever proposed to interact with quarks, its Lorentz character and gauge representation must be specified and the allowed gauge-invariant operators derived. Until that is done, the symbolic and particle layers remain related by analogy rather than mechanism.
research_question: Can the project preserve an up/down symbolic state coordinate without confusing it with quark quantum numbers, and—if a physical Potato-sector coupling is later proposed—which lowest-dimension Lorentz- and Standard-Model-gauge-invariant quark operators are actually allowed?
purpose: Preserve the recovered up/down-quark polarity model without confusing valid Standard Model facts with project symbolism or unsupported claims about consciousness, morality, gravity or social behavior.
recovered_project_core: The conversation used the names up and down as a natural symbolic polarity for ascent versus drag/grounding.
The later 11D synthesis associated the up-quark side with Spudlight/ascending signal and the down-quark side with Mud/weight.
This polarity was connected in conversation to the broader upward/downward Spiral and Axis vocabulary.

physics_corrections: An up quark is not a photon, light particle or literal carrier of Spudlight; positive fractional charge does not mean upward motion or higher frequency.
A down quark is not gravity, mud or a generic carrier of mass; both flavors have mass and participate in Standard Model interactions.
Most nucleon mass arises from QCD dynamics rather than simple addition of bare quark masses.
Human choices, morality, attention or social identity do not change proton/neutron valence-quark composition in the project sense.
No evidence supports moral actions changing Calabi-Yau geometry, quark flavor balance or literal subatomic timelines.
relation_to_unification_lineage: Standard Model/QCD supplies the particle facts.
Any future physical Potato-quark coupling must be written through a gauge-consistent Lagrangian rather than inferred from the words up/down.

future_testable_route.question: Could a hypothetical UPT field P couple to quark bilinears in a gauge-consistent EFT?
future_testable_route.candidate_research_form: After defining P's Lorentz character and gauge representation, enumerate symmetry-allowed operators by mass dimension and compare with established portal EFTs.
future_testable_route.advancement_gate: Promote a physical branch only after an explicit invariant operator, parameter regime and observable consequence are derived.
future_testable_route.boundary: This is future model building, not evidence for the historical symbolic mapping.

failure_conditions: Symbolic labels are treated as evidence for physical quark behavior.
A proposed P-quark term is not Lorentz or Standard-Model gauge invariant in the declared representation.
The physical branch produces no observable distinction from a simpler established EFT after complexity is accounted for.
